# Omnis Education
> AI-powered learning and SEND management platform for UK secondary schools.

## What is Omnis?

Omnis is a multi-tenant SaaS platform built specifically for UK state secondary schools (Years 7–13). It integrates the full teaching, SEND, and pastoral workflow into a single platform — replacing disconnected spreadsheets, legacy MIS exports, and paper-based SEND records.

The platform is currently in beta. Beta schools receive full access at no cost during the programme.

## Core capabilities

- **AI homework generation**: Teachers generate MCQ, short-answer, and extended-writing homework using Claude AI. EHCP and SEN Support students automatically receive differentiated question variants based on their ILP provisions. Auto-marking returns GCSE 1–9 grades with per-question feedback.
- **SEND / ILP / EHCP management**: Individual Learning Plans, Education Health and Care Plans, K Plans, and Assess-Plan-Do-Review (APDR) cycles — all in one place. AI-assisted ILP generation, homework evidence linking, early-warning flags, and SENCO oversight dashboards.
- **Adaptive learning**: Per-student learning profiles updated after every submission. Bloom's taxonomy heatmaps, weak-topic detection, and spaced repetition suggestions for every class.
- **Analytics**: GCSE-grade attainment (1–9 scale), RAG status, SEND attainment gap analysis, national JCQ benchmark comparisons, and school-wide staff performance analytics.
- **MIS sync via Wonde**: Live sync of students, staff, classes, timetables, and attendance from any Wonde-connected school MIS (SIMS, Bromcom, Arbor, iSAMS, etc.).
- **Lesson planning**: Weekly teacher calendar, Oak National Academy resource integration (11,000+ lessons), cover management, and year-group revision programs.
- **Pastoral & compliance**: Head of Year dashboards, detention and exclusion registers, safeguarding records, academic integrity signals, GDPR consent management, and immutable audit logging for UK GDPR Article 9 compliance.

## Who uses Omnis?

12 staff and stakeholder roles: Teacher, SENCO, SLT, Head of Year, Head of Department, Teaching Assistant, School Admin, Cover Manager, Platform Admin, Academy Admin (MAT), Student, Parent.

Each role has a tailored interface — teachers see their class calendar and marking queue; SENCOs see ILP caseloads and early-warning flags; SLT sees school-wide attainment vs national benchmarks; parents see their child's progress and GDPR consent options.

## Market context

- 3,600+ UK state secondary schools
- 1 in 5 pupils has special educational needs (SEND)
- £2.4bn UK EdTech market
- SEND Code of Practice 2015 mandates ILP/EHCP documentation — Omnis digitises and automates this compliance requirement

## Technology stack

Next.js 16 · React 19 · Tailwind CSS v4 · Prisma v6 · PostgreSQL (Supabase) · NextAuth v5 · Anthropic Claude (claude-sonnet-4-6) · Resend · Playwright · Deployed on Coolify / DigitalOcean
